title: Lightly Seasoned Jamaican Snapper Fish Grill
description: A funky and tender Jamaican dish featuring snapper fish, perfect for a romantic evening, shojin-friendly and brine-dry to preserve the delicate flavor of the fish. This recipe is a great way to experience the bold flavors of Jamaica.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, whisk together lime juice, olive oil, jerk seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Place the snapper fish fillets in a shallow dish and brush the jerk seasoning mixture evenly over both sides of the fish.
Let the fish marinate for 15 minutes to allow the flavors to penetrate.
Remove the fish from the marinade and place it on the grill.
Close the grill lid and cook for 4 minutes per side, or until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Transfer the fish to a plate and garnish with chopped scallions.
For an added touch, serve with a side of grilled vegetables or a fresh salad.
